title: Completed-ring representative of reduced evaluation
statement: Fix coefficient data, a normalized tensor presentation a and reduction presentation m as in [def-sf-integral-hom-reduction-models]. Let P and I represent K and L, with P K-flat and I K-injective. Let Q be any K-flat coefficient resolution augmented quasi-isomorphically to the restricted level-n quotient unit. For a map f:Hom(P,I) tensor Q -> Hom(P,I tensor Q) satisfying [lem-sf-two-term-free-hom-tensor-components] signed formula, put F=derived reduction, U=restriction, H=Hom_R(K,L), X=UFH and J=I tensor Q. There are r:UFL isomorphic to Qloc(J) and s:X isomorphic to Qloc(Hom(P,I) tensor Q), such that the completed-ring tensor-Hom uncurrying of s followed by Qloc(f), homModelMap(P,J), and Hom(eP inverse,r inverse), equals the scalar-adjunction image of mu(K,X), tensor(id_FK,counit_FH), mu(K,H) inverse, and F(evaluation_R). No boundedness or finite-freeness of Q, no K-injectivity of J, and no finite-coefficient internal-Hom comparison is asserted.

proof.text: Choose K-flat resolutions of I and Hom(P,I). Tensor their augmentation maps with the supplied K-flat Q and tensor epsilon with these K-flat resolutions. These operations preserve quasi-isomorphisms. The ordinary extension-tensor comparison identifies tensor with the restricted quotient unit with restricted scalar extension. The left-derived-to-ordinary comparison for scalar extension is invertible on the K-flat resolutions. Their localizations construct r and s, transporting through eI, eP and the canonical Hom localization isomorphism.

Resolve the testing complex K-flatly. Since P is K-flat and I is K-injective, Hom(P,I) is K-injective, so testing maps are represented by chain maps. Apply a.evaluation to these maps and m.normalization to scalar extension units. On homogeneous sections the evaluation sign (-1)^(ij) and signed exchange sign (-1)^(bp) give exactly the sign for reduced evaluation. The same augmentation epsilon appears in both paths. Tensor-sheafification descent and Hom product projections identify the chain morphisms; localizing gives the displayed equality with the scalar counit on F(Hom(K,L)). This step does not assert that I tensor Q is K-injective and uses no finite-coefficient internal Hom.

theorem reduced_evaluation_representative
    (a : TensorPresentation.{t, u} Y (completedIntegralCommRingSheaf l E Y D hl))
    (n : ℕ) (m : ReductionPresentation l E Y D hl a n)
    (K L : completedIntegralDerivedCategory l E Y D hl)
    (P I Q : CochainComplex (completedIntegralModuleSheaves l E Y D hl) ℤ)
    (hP : flat.{t, u} Y (completedIntegralCommRingSheaf l E Y D hl) P) (hI : I.IsKInjective)
    (eP : DerivedCategory.Q.obj P ≅ K)
    (eI : DerivedCategory.Q.obj I ≅ L)
    (hQ : flat.{t, u} Y (completedIntegralCommRingSheaf l E Y D hl) Q)
    (epsilon : Q ⟶
      ((scalarReductionRestriction l E Y n).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj
        ((CochainComplex.singleFunctor (scalarReductionTarget l E Y n) 0).obj
          (SheafOfModules.unit (integralCoefficientSheaf l E Y n))))
    (hepsilon : QuasiIso epsilon)
    (f : ((totalTensor.{t, u} Y (completedIntegralCommRingSheaf l E Y D hl)).obj
          (homComplex.{t + 1, t, max u (t + 1), max u (t + 1)}
            (R := completedIntegralCommRingSheaf l E Y D hl) P I)).obj Q ⟶
        homComplex.{t + 1, t, max u (t + 1), max u (t + 1)}
          (R := completedIntegralCommRingSheaf l E Y D hl) P
          (((totalTensor.{t, u} Y (completedIntegralCommRingSheaf l E Y D hl)).obj I).obj Q))
    (hf : IsSignedHomTensor Y (completedIntegralCommRingSheaf l E Y D hl) P I Q f) :
    let R := completedIntegralCommRingSheaf l E Y D hl
    let U := scalarReductionDerivedRestriction l E Y n
    let F := integralDerivedReduction l E Y D hl n
    let adj := (derivedScalarExtensionRestrictionAdjunction l E Y n).choose
    let H := (hom.{t, u} Y R).obj (op K, L)
    let X := U.obj (F.obj H)
    let J := ((totalTensor.{t, u} Y R).obj I).obj Q
    ∃ (r : U.obj (F.obj L) ≅ DerivedCategory.Q.obj J)
      (s : X ≅ DerivedCategory.Q.obj (((totalTensor.{t, u} Y R).obj
        (homComplex.{t + 1, t, max u (t + 1), max u (t + 1)} (R := R) P I)).obj Q)),
      ((a.adjunction K).homEquiv X (U.obj (F.obj L))).symm
          (s.hom ≫ DerivedCategory.Q.map f ≫ homModelMap.{t, u} Y R P J ≫
            (hom.{t, u} Y R).map (Prod.mkHom eP.inv.op r.inv)) =
        adj.homEquiv (a.tensor.obj (K, X)) (F.obj L)
          (m.mu.hom.app (K, X) ≫
            m.target.tensor.map (Prod.mkHom (𝟙 (F.obj K)) (adj.counit.app (F.obj H))) ≫
            m.mu.inv.app (K, H) ≫ F.map ((a.adjunction K).counit.app L))
